name: Restricted FIN Active Or Historic Currency And Amount
definition: Number of monetary units specified in an active or a historic currency where the unit of currency is explicit and compliant with ISO 4217.
format: Required format is digits with an optional decimal point, for example 1500.25, at most 14 digits in total, of which at most 5 after the decimal point, not negative

CurrencyAmount.definition: The number of fractional digits (or minor unit of currency) must comply with ISO 4217.|Note: The decimal separator is a dot.
